final_protocol:
1. Set up an Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose 1% cassette, single-channel pipette with tips, tube rack, and microcentrifuge tubes labeled DNA and ladder kept on ice.

2. Load an aliquot from the ladder microcentrifuge tube into a well of the E-Gel EX agarose 1% cassette using a single-channel pipette.

3. Load aliquots from the DNA microcentrifuge tube into the remaining selected wells of the E-Gel EX agarose 1% cassette using a single-channel pipette and fresh tips.

4. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

5. Close the E-Gel Power Snap lid, select the E-Gel EX 1–2% gel program, and start the run for 10:00 min.
